rationale: The assistant correctly identified this as normal heat pump dryer behaviour from the first reply, explained the condenser-vs-heat-pump difference the customer didn't know, and addressed the customer's own door-opening habit, cold location, spin speed and filters as lengthening factors. It confirmed the model, hedged appropriately ('probably normal', 'roughly'), gave clear and correct criteria for when to call Bosch under warranty, and recommended no parts. The only shortfall is that it listed factors rather than directly asking about room temperature and door opening, so it never learned the dryer is in an 8-10°C garage, though its advice already covered that case.
